capabilities: Render nested markdown lists as one-column-per-depth Miller column views
Navigate the tree with keyboard keys (hjkl, arrows, Tab activation)
Toggle checkboxes and write changes back to the note
Insert, delete, and flip task/bullet items from the column view
Configure column width, chevrons, and item wrapping
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; must be installed by copying files or via BRAT. Only '-' lists are supported; renaming must be done in the source note.
problem: Deeply nested lists in Obsidian force you to scroll a long outline; there is no built-in column view to traverse and edit a tree level by level.
summary: Renders nested markdown lists tagged #miller-view as Finder-style horizontal columns for walking trees and managing tasks.
